name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: The bar at the top of a page, which takes its material once content scrolls under it.
use: The top of a page or an app: the brand, the main links and a few actions. It sticks to the top of its scroll container. Below 36rem of bar the links step aside for a toggle that opens the same links in a menu or a drawer.

instead.when: The main destinations of a small-screen app sit along the bottom edge
The destinations stack in a sidebar
The links switch between views of one page

platform.fallback: The pane is always drawn, at the top of the page too

classes.name: navbar
classes.description: The sticky bar, on a header; a size and scroll-state container named navbar. It has no material until content scrolls under it

classes.name: navbar-floating
classes.description: A bar with a margin around it, a surface corner and its material from the start

classes.name: navbar-brand
classes.description: The mark and the name, as one link home; it also stands alone at the head of a shell or a sidebar

classes.name: navbar-nav
classes.description: The row of main links, on a nav with a label; hidden below 36rem of bar

classes.name: navbar-link
classes.description: A link or a button in the row: a word at rest, on a chip under the pointer

classes.name: navbar-end
classes.description: The actions at the far end

classes.name: navbar-toggle
classes.description: On the button that opens the links in a menu or a drawer; shown only while navbar-nav is hidden

classes.name: navbar-progress
classes.description: A reading-progress line along the foot of the bar, which fills as the page scrolls; give it role="presentation"

states.name: current
states.description: The current page is in strong ink

states.name: open
states.description: A button in the row whose menu is open stays in strong ink

properties.name: --navbar-color
properties.description: The color the pane is tinted with; match the page behind it
